---
title: "A county's boundary history"
---

A state's county-level geography across every Gazetteer vintage the catalog
carries — run live. Connecticut (the default) is the clearest example: eight
legacy counties through 2020, replaced by nine planning regions in 2022 (see
[Concepts › Boundary vintages](/concepts/boundaries.qmd)).

{{< include _duckdb-shared.qmd >}}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof stateChoice = Inputs.select(US_STATES, {
  label: "State",
  format: (d) => d.name,
  value: US_STATES.find((s) => s.fips === "09")
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sql = `SELECT vintage, geo_id, name, round(aland_m2 / 1e6, 1) AS land_km2
FROM coi.geography.unit
WHERE level = 'county' AND parent_geo_id = 'state:${stateChoice.fips}' AND valid_to IS NULL
ORDER BY vintage, geo_id`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
queryState = {
  sql; // reactive dependency
  if (dbState.status !== "ready") return dbState;
  const t0 = performance.now();
  try {
    const result = await dbState.conn.query(sql);
    return { status: "ready", rows: rowsFromArrow(result), ms: performance.now() - t0 };
  } catch (error) {
    return { status: "error", error };
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
renderStatus(dbState, queryState)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
queryState.status === "ready"
  ? Inputs.table(queryState.rows, { columns: ["vintage", "geo_id", "name", "land_km2"] })
  : html`<p><em>Table will render once the query returns.</em></p>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
queryState.status === "ready"
  ? html`<p class="recipe-status">County count by vintage: ${
      Array.from(d3.rollup(queryState.rows, (v) => v.length, (d) => d.vintage))
        .sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0])
        .map(([v, n]) => `${v}: ${n}`)
        .join(", ")
    }</p>`
  : ""
```
